description: This course traces the development of the idea of authentic existence in the Existentialist tradition beginning with Søren Kierkegaard, then through thinkers such as Martin Heidegger, Simone de Beauvoir, Jean-Paul Sartre, Hannah Arendt, and Albert Camus. Among other things, we will observe how ethical thinking has moved from the language of duty to that of personal answerability, and how the search for meaningful existence has increasingly become the responsibility of the individual. Offered annually.
name: Existentialism
